answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 28222 Country: India Title: If there is too cold,and during the night if there is aetelam,then what to do for the fajr namaz? Question: As salamo alaiku wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.If there is too cold,and during the night if there is aetelam,then what to do for the fajr namaz? Answer ID: 28222 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 49/39/H=1432) Perform ghusl with hot water and offer Fajr salah with jama’ah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
